verdict.rationale: Letta documents an official TypeScript Agent SDK (`@letta-ai/letta-agent-sdk`, `client.createAgent()`) that includes memory APIs: starting memory entries and persona/human conveniences. The pack contains no evidence of an official Python SDK, so the multi-language requirement and cross-language memory-API equivalence are unproven. missing for 10: an official Python SDK, documented memory-API parity between Python and TypeScript, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build against official SDKs in at least Python and TypeScript with equivalent memory APIs

citations.quote: the Letta Agent SDK for building agents into TypeScript applications
Browser, Expo, and React Native applications must import the SDK from `@letta-ai/letta-agent-sdk/client`
Pass memory for full control over the agent’s starting memory. Each entry becomes a Markdown file in the agent’s memory repository
`persona` and `human` are conveniences that set the agent's persona and human memory
